849 Rustling Circle
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$429,900, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,279 SF, MLS# 553939

Acres plus amenities just down the road a piece from the city Copperas Cove, Texas. This beautiful 3 bedrooms, 2 baths 2 car garage home sits on 2.29 acres of land has been fully upgraded with stainless steel kitchen appliances, granite counter tops in the kitchen and master bedroom. wood laminate wood flooring in bedrooms, family and great rooms, upgraded tile flooring in the kitchen and baths. It has a second family room with wood burning fireplace fit well with those holiday family gatherings. And for the "Real McCoy" there's a green house for growing veggies and a chicken coup at real of the property for raising chickens and gathering eggs.  There are endless possibilities for this country home. Simply glorious, Text, call or email today.

2 full bath
